purpose: Durable PostgreSQL 1С installation, organization-binding, one-time pairing and scoped machine-credential authority, plus bounded human management and connector pairing bootstrap routes; no operational exchange or provider traffic.
requiredInvariants: ConnectorInstallation identity is global by opaque databaseInstanceId; organization and tenant authority live only on explicit binding and credential state.
The retained installation tenant_id column is a forward-only NULL-constrained tombstone and is never read by final authorization functions.
Pairing plaintext and machine bearer plaintext are returned once and never persisted or audited.
One-time pairing consumption is atomic; replay fails and a failed discovery match does not consume the challenge.
The server selects exactly one discovered 1С legal entity by platform INN/KPP; client input cannot select another platform organization or 1С GUID as authority.
One installation/GUID cannot bind to two platform organizations even across tenants.
Credential rotation and binding revoke make old machine credentials invalid immediately.
Ordinary runtime principals have no direct connector-table CRUD; bounded functions plus FORCE RLS remain the database boundary.
Only connector pairing is public; human management requires DB-proven membership/capability and risky writes require fresh MFA.
Heartbeat, jobs, ACK/result/fail, events and mappings remain closed; no provider traffic, production credential, production deployment or certification claim is introduced.
Migration changes remain forward-only and no new mandatory recurring cost is introduced.
